transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining this planning check-in. As you know, the Product Support and Customer Education teams merged last month, and I'm organizing a two-hour workshop to help the groups establish effective working relationships. I have two available slots: October 9th from 1:00 to 3:00 PM, or October 10th from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Jordan and Priya are the possible facilitators, and I'll be making the final arrangements. The workshop can be conducted either in person with a remote participation option, or entirely in person. Before I book anything, I'd like each of you to share any relevant commitments, access needs, or process requirements you have. That way we can make sure the workshop works for everyone involved.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I should let everyone know that I've already agreed in a separate employee-network planning thread to facilitate the workshop on October 10th from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM, and I'm not available to facilitate the October 9th slot. That agreement wasn't copied into Elena's workshop draft, so I want to make sure it's on the table here.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have an approved hearing accommodation that requires remote participation with live captions and at least 48 hours of agenda notice. I haven't yet requested that this specific workshop use the accommodation, but I'm sharing it now so it can be factored into the planning. Given that, I'd need the workshop to include a remote participation option with live captions, and I'd need the agenda at least 48 hours in advance. Regarding facilitation, I'm available for either slot, but Jordan has already committed to the October 10th slot, so I could facilitate the October 9th slot if needed.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Before I forget — I checked with HR this week and there are some post-merger relationship workshop requirements that need to be applied here. The workshop must not be recorded, it must accept anonymous questions, and we must publish a written response memo within 5 business days after the workshop. I haven't added this guidance to Elena's draft yet, but I want to make sure it's factored into the planning now.
transcript.speaker: A4
